Test Beast
Gargantuan Monstrosity (Titan), Unaligned
AC 25
HP 697 (34d20 + 340)
Actions

Bite. Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 15 ft. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) Piercing damage.

Bonus Actions

Swallow. Strength Saving Throw: DC 27, one Large or smaller creature. Failure: The target is swallowed.

If the beast takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it regurgitates all swallowed creatures.

Legendary Actions

Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature’s turn, the beast can expend a use to take one of the following actions.

Onslaught. The beast moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Bite attack.

The test beast is a legend told to frighten travellers.

It sleeps for centuries and wakes hungry.
